verdict.rationale: Transactional sending is a fair question for an email marketing platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents only marketing emails: the Marketing Emails API, drag-and-drop marketing templates, recipient exclusions and unengaged-contact suppression. Nothing shows a separate transactional stream with its own templates, suppression rules or sending reputation, or one that delivers to unsubscribed contacts.

support.subject: As an ops user, transactional email is kept separate from marketing — its own templates, suppression rules, and reputation — so a receipt still delivers to an unsubscribed contact
